fragen.text: I am a loving and empathetic person in relationships.
Romantic relationships tend to be hard to come by in my life.
I am ambitious and set myself clear career goals.
At work I often feel underestimated or passed over.
I consider myself skilled in financial matters.
I find it hard to take care of my money matters.
I generally have a lot of energy and physical vitality.
After illness or strain it takes me a long time to get my strength back.
I like being around people and feel comfortable in groups.
Making new contacts takes an effort for me.
I consider myself a creative person.
I prefer to stick to proven solutions rather than try something new.
Significant changes happen often in my life.
Changes in my life tend to make me uncomfortable.
Spiritual or metaphysical topics are an important part of my life.
When making decisions I rely on facts rather than on my gut feeling.
